summary: Verification round. review-scope exited 0: 1 of 47 blocks changed (pr-code, 2%), and no section or objective changed. The previous review had no open must-fix items, so there are no resolved entries. I reviewed pr-code in full. The CLAUDE.md rule was shortened from 「…で始める」 to 「- <title>は「練習：」から」 to fit 390 px. In context it still means "starts with", and it matches what pr-prompt-a/b, c-claude-md and pr-answer check, so there is no regression. One niceToHave suggests a less elliptical wording and notes that the brief quotes the old line. I re-scored practice (3) and load (3); the other criteria are carried over. Validate and lint --strict are clean (0 errors, 0 warnings). Measure: prose 1945, est 19.8 min against estMinutes 20. Every criterion is 3 or above, the mean is 3.46 and there are no must-fix items, so the verdict is pass.
